Ushintsho lapha kusho ukukhipha isoftware entsha okumele idlule kuzo zonke izihlolo zomthethosisekelo ezizenzakalelayo ngaphambi kokuba ithunyelwe — ukuthambisa kwenzeka kuphela ngalo mnyango, obala, ushintsho nokuhlola kwalo kurekhodi lomphakathi.
system_amendments.no_amendments_yet_ever: Ayikho imisebenzi yokulungisa okwamanje — zonke izinguquko zizovela lapha, zengezwe, hhayi ukuthi zishintshwe.
system_amendments.settings_the_constitut: Izilungiselelo umthethosisekelo ozishiyela indawo yegunya ngalowo, ezishintshwa isinqumo somthetho esivumelekile (ushintsho lwesilungiselelo olulungiseka) ngendlela ejwayelekile yomthethosivivinywa. Injini ivimba izixazululo ezingaphandle komngcele ngaphambi kokuba ukhetho kuhlelelwe. Zonke izinguquko ezifakwe zifika lapha, erekhodi eliphilayo — zengezwe, hhayi ukuthi zishintshwe.
system_amendments.supermajority_glossed_: Iningi elikhethekile, incazelo: isabelo sawo wonke amalungu ahleli ezisihlalweni — izihlalo ezingenamuntu zisabala ekuhlaleni kuze kube yilapho zigcwaliswe — ngakho ukungabikho angeke kube ukwehlisa izinga.
system_amendments.the_constitution_chang: Umthethosisekelo ushintsha ngeminyango emibili kuphela. Izilungiselelo ozishiyela ovulekile zishintsha ngesinqumo somthetho esijwayelekile, phakathi kwemingcele evaliwe. Inyoni evaliwe uqobo lwayo (igama eliqinile) ishintsha kuphela ngokukhipha isoftware entsha, eyenziwe obala lapho zonke izihlolo zomthethosisekelo zidlula obala. Akukho okushintsha ngokuthula, futhi akukho okushintsha ngendlela eyinye.
system_amendments.the_supermajority_frac: Ingxenye yeningi elikhethekile ilungiseka, kodwa incazelo yayo inezinga eliphansi eliqinile: akukho ukuncazela kabusha okungakhiqiza umngcele ongaphansi kweningi + 1 yawo wonke amalungu asebenza. Okujwayelekile kungamathathu emibili, kubalwa ngokuhambisana namalungu asebenza, hhayi amalungu akhona.
system_amendments.this_screen_shows_the_: Leli skrini likhombisa izindlela ezimbili umthethosisekelo ongashintsha ngazo — umnyango wezilungiselelo uhamba ngoshintsho lwesilungiselelo olulungiseka nendlela ejwayelekile yomthethosivivinywa, futhi zonke izinguquko zibondiswe ekhasheni lokucwaninga. Izilungiselelo ezilungiseka zihlelwe ngokwe-indawo yegunya; ukugunyazwa kukhuphuka ekhasheni lokuhlanganisa ngokwe-iningi elikhethekile lomvoti. Ngamazwi wobunjiniyela, igama eliqinile liwuhlu lwezifayela ezivikelekile ezigcinwe yi-suite yokuhlola umthethosisekelo — ukukhishwa kwenzeka kuphela lapha lapho i-suite ephelele idlula.
system_auditchain.everything_that_happen: Konke okwenzeka lapha — wonke ukhetho, isinqumo senkantolo, ukukhetho, noshintsho lomthetho — kubhalwa emlandweni owodwa ophala lapho akekho, hhayi ngisho nomphathi, isishayamthetho, noma ijaji, ongashintsha ngokuthula. system_clocks.the_scheduler_itself_is_th: Isihleli ngokwaso siyinjini engemuva kokuvumelanisa izikhathi zokusebenza kanye nokuqinisekisa imihlangano yezinsuku ezingu-90. Le khasi lihamba njengesincazelo sesihleli — isihleli sokukhiqiza sisebenzisa leziirekhodi zesiklokho ngqo, umugqa owodwa, omthombo ovusa owodwa. Izinto ezimiselwe ezishintshwayo zishintsha ngesinqumo sesishayamthetho; iziklokho eziqinisiwe nezesakhiwo zizimele ekodweni. Iziklokho ngokwazo azigcini isimo — zihambisa ezinye izinto (ukukhetho, amandla esimo esiphuthumayo, izihlalo ezingenamuntu, izicelo zokuhlala) ezigabeni zazo.
